description: This Dart file defines the DashboardScreen widget and associated components for a Flutter application. It displays monthly financial statistics and charts, fetches data via ReportsProvider, and manages UI states for loading and empty data.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying the dashboard with stats and charts.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the dashboard's dynamic data and interactions.

classes.name: _HeaderBar
classes.description: Widget providing the header with date selection and title.

classes.name: _StatsRow
classes.description: Widget displaying key financial statistics in a responsive layout.

classes.name: _StatTile
classes.description: Reusable tile widget for individual statistics.

classes.name: _TopCategoryTile
classes.description: Displays the top expense category details.

classes.name: _ChartsGrid
classes.description: Container for the line chart and pie chart, with loading states.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes data fetch for the current month upon widget creation.

methods.name: _onMonthChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected month and triggers data reload.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire dashboard UI, including charts and stats.

methods.name: _monthLabel
methods.description: Converts month integer to abbreviated month name.

methods.name: _formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a double value into a currency string.
